the renormalized Random-Phase- Approximation is the most promising approximation for the thermodynamic properties of many- particle systems in the intermediate density regime.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a functional-integral representation of the grand-canonical partition-function leads to a renormalized R.P.A., which is stationary with respect the two-particle density correlation-function.
the grand-canonical partition functions are Gaussian averages of the partition function of non-interacting particles in an external random potential.

the renormalized-RPA is a very simple and natural approximation to a many-body theory.
